changelog: fix: ClusterTree + bar (12b): the tree's branches ran through the sample names. The names were drawn at the leaf tips with hjust=1, which puts the text back over the tree's own branches. They are now the bar panel's axis labels, between the tree and the bars, with a gap after the tips. The tree is computed directly from hclust (no ggdendro), and both panels use the same fixed row range so each leaf lines up with its bar. ggdendro is no longer needed for this figure. Verified by rendering the figure in R from the U2BI-139 tables.

previous.changelog: fix: the remaining [WARN] lines from the 2.9.29 render log. These were not re-render problems: the same lines are in a normal run's pipeline.log, and each one is a figure or table that has never been produced. (1) Faith's PD: picante needs a rooted tree; the pipeline's tree is unrooted, so it is now midpoint-rooted (phangorn, else rooted on the first tip). (2) UniFrac PCoA/NMDS (20a-d) ran on ps, which carries no tree by design, so 'phy_tree slot is empty' four times; they now use ps_tree (midpoint-rooted if needed). (3) Metastats: the same per-taxon rbind failure as STAMP ('names do not match previous names'); now built column by column, names split across lineages summed. (4) ClusterTree+Bar (12b) called ggdendro::geom_segment/geom_text, which do not exist; they are ggplot2's. (5) DESeq2 heatmap stopped on duplicate row names ('Unclassified' twice); the labels are made unique. (6) LEfSe: lefser renamed groupCol to classCol; the old name was ignored and lefser looked for a column called GROUP. The argument name is now chosen from the installed lefser, unused group levels dropped, and newer output ('features') accepted. (7) Rank abundance (03c): rebuilt without the per-sample rbind, and the warning now names the failing call if it still fails. (8) STAMP subtitle no longer runs off the right edge: the small-sample note is on its own line and the title block starts at the figure edge. Left as is: FUNGuildR is for ITS (fungi) and is not used for 16S. Verified in R where the container allows (rank abundance and Metastats blocks on the U2BI-139 tables); viz_pipeline.R parses. Not verifiable here without phyloseq/picante/lefser/DESeq2: those are checked by the next render's log.
